children: Forgent Power Solutions' revenue rose 69% and net income attributable to the company increased 382% year over year, driven by higher Custom Products and Powertrain Solutions sales amid growing demand and additional capacity across its campuses. Lower interest expense also supported results.
Revenue was $478.57M, compared with $283.27M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 68.9%.
Net income was $48.24M, compared with $10.01M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 381.8%.
: Higher Custom Products and Powertrain Solutions sales drove revenue growth across end markets.
: Additional capacity added at all campuses helped meet customer demand.
: Gross profit rose 62%; cost of revenues as a percentage of revenues increased amid accelerated headcount growth, campus ramp-up costs and startup costs.
: Capital spending was $31.7 million, primarily for capacity expansion.
